text:
14/03/26, 8:15 pm - Karthik bhai: Haan bolo guys, aaj ka payment reconcile hua kya?
14/03/26, 8:20 pm - Pooja S.: Karthik bhai, mai dekh rahi hu. Ek QR code scan fail ho gaya tha.
14/03/26, 8:25 pm - Kavita didi: Konsa vala QR? Customer ka status kya hai?
14/03/26, 8:31 pm - Pooja S.: Wo uncle bol rahe the ki unke account se 15,000 debit ho gaye.
14/03/26, 8:37 pm - Karthik bhai: Lekin hamare Merchant app pe to credit display nahi hua.
14/03/26, 8:42 pm - Pooja didi: Screenshot bheja unhone?
14/03/26, 8:48 pm - Pooja S.: Haan, fake screenshot lag raha hai mujhe. Font thoda ajeeb hai.
14/03/26, 8:53 pm - Kavita didi: Wait, maine unko refund collect link toh nahi bhej diya galati se?
14/03/26, 9:00 pm - Karthik bhai: Kavita didi, aapne pin enter karne ko toh nahi bola na?
14/03/26, 9:05 pm - Kavita didi: Nahi nahi, bas UPI request dali thi unhone bola tab.
14/03/26, 9:12 pm - Pooja S.: Arre par collect request se hamare account se paise cut jayenge!
14/03/26, 9:18 pm - Karthik bhai: Shit, kitne ka transaction tha exact?
14/03/26, 9:22 pm - Kavita didi: Around 45,000 deduct ho gaye hamare main account se!
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja didi: Kavita didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
14/03/26, 9:32 pm - Kavita didi: Theek hai didi, chat se delete kar diya.
14/03/26, 9:38 pm - Pooja S.: Wait, didi record kyun delete kar rahe ho? Bank ko report karna padega!
14/03/26, 9:45 pm - Karthik bhai: Fraud hua hai, audit me pakde jayenge hum sab.
14/03/26, 9:51 pm - Pooja didi: Tum dono chup raho, pehle Cyber Cell helpline 1930 pe call karo.
14/03/26, 9:58 pm - Kavita didi: Maine bank ka helpline number bhi dial kiya hai, hold pe hu.
14/03/26, 10:04 pm - Karthik bhai: Transaction reference ID hai kisi ke paas save?
14/03/26, 10:10 pm - Pooja S.: Haan maine pehle hi screenshot le liya tha safety ke liye.
14/03/26, 10:15 pm - Pooja didi: Jaldi bhej wo file, complaint register karani hai urgent.
